## New
- F-key shortcuts in E-Sys: F2 Connect, F3 Coding, F4 TAL-Processing, F6 FSC Extended, F7 VCM, F9 Fault scan. Change or turn off each key in Settings > Shortcuts in E-Sys. A key only opens the screen; nothing is sent to the car.

## Fixed
- Take me there now finds VCM, FSC Extended and Coding-Verification on newer E-Sys versions.
- Fault clearing, module restart, battery registration and ignition check that the same car is still connected first.
- Safer handling of text in cheat sheets and search.
- EDIABAS and PSdZData set up by another Windows user are no longer used without asking.
- Small fixes and checks.
